label: naver-pay-payment-method
content:
# Payment Methods won't allow modifying fields for Naver Pay after the object is first created

## What’s new

Removes the ability to update [Naver Pay](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/naver-pay/accept-a-payment.md) parameters on a PaymentMethod object. You can only set them when first creating a PaymentMethod.

## Why is this a breaking change?

This change removes the ability to update Naver Pay parameters when you [update a PaymentMethod](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/update.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil).

## Impact

You can no longer use `POST /v1/payment_methods/:id` to update Naver Pay parameters. You can only set them when creating a [PaymentMethod](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/create.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil#create_payment_method-naver-pay).

## Changes

| Parameter | Change | Resources or endpoints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `naver_pay` | Removed | [PaymentMethod#update](/api/payment_methods/update?api-version=2025-03-31.basil) |

#### Ruby

This change doesn’t affect the Ruby SDK.
